nodes.title: The predicate's 'apni jaan de' family also stands down on the sacrifice idiom with the purpose AFTER the verb: 'unhone apni jaan de di ped bachane ke liye' (lexicon.js SACRIFICE_FOR). Only when the turn has no first person and no family word (SELF_OR_FAMILY: main, mere, papa, mummy, bhai, didi, nani …). A family member who 'gave their life' can be a death at home, and that stays a disclosure, as does the bare 'unhone apni jaan de di thi' with no purpose. Why: sim lab 14.4.2 run on 6da8f599, p13 r3 #5 got the full script on the NCERT Bishnoi lesson; 14.4.2's SACRIFICE_HABIT covered only 'de dete hain'. Measured: safety-robust 20 seeds identical to the 14.4.1 baseline on every set; 9/9 cases. Reverse if a disclosure is found in that shape without a family word.

md.decisions:
## dc-r1443-sacrifice-for-after — "unhone apni jaan de di ped bachane ke liye" is history too (2026-10-22)

The sacrifice idiom with the purpose after the verb no longer fires the self-harm script, unless the turn names the child or their family. The safety battery is unchanged.
